fichas.title: Platform Furniture and Raster22
fichas.summary: DB Station&Service AG developed Raster22 (Grid22), a product-independent dimension and interface system for platform weather protection, wall elements, display cases and seating. The system coordinates furniture and construction components, supports combinations from different manufacturers, and includes seating, display cases, and weather-protection structures. The page also notes railway approval requirements and exemptions for small buildings.
